to do nothing; to do the bare minimum, to coast, to slack off, to quiet quit; to let things run their course without intervening

examples.english: Thus we arrive at the expression doing the plank, which appears to have become established in the national language in the mid-20th century, in order to indicate that someone is doing the minimum indispensable in an activity or job.
examples.ref: 2020, Sergio Vázquez, 1000 expresiones que se usan en la Argentina, Facultad de Periodismo y Comunicación Social, Universidad Nacional de La Plata:
examples.text: Así llegamos a la expresión hacer la plancha, que parece se impuso en el lenguaje nacional a mediados del siglo XX, con el fin de indicar que alguien está haciendo lo mínimo indispensable en una actividad o trabajo.
examples.translation: Thus we arrive at the expression doing the plank, which appears to have become established in the national language in the mid-20th century, in order to indicate that someone is doing the minimum indispensable in an activity or job.

examples.english: Doing the plank is not moving, not growing, not contributing.
examples.ref: 2025 July 6, Leo Piccioli, “Cómo frenar la epidemia silenciosa de la falta de compromiso laboral”, in Forbes Argentina, retrieved 01 Oct 2026:
examples.text: Hacer la plancha es no moverse, no crecer, no aportar.
examples.translation: Doing the plank is not moving, not growing, not contributing.

examples.english: "They are doing the plank," joked a source close to the talks between the unions.
examples.ref: 2025 January 20, “Hacer la plancha, renovar la imagen y suponer que cambiará el humor social”, in El Litoral, retrieved 01 Oct 2026:
examples.text: "Están haciendo la plancha", ironizó una fuente que está al tanto de las conversaciones entre los gremios.
examples.translation: "They are doing the plank," joked a source close to the talks between the unions.

examples.english: the governor of Santa Cruz tends to do the plank and avoid dangerous exposure.
examples.ref: 2003 May 7, La Voz del Interior, retrieved 01 Oct 2026:
examples.text: el gobernador de Santa Cruz tiende a hacer la plancha y a evitar las exposiciones peligrosas.
examples.translation: the governor of Santa Cruz tends to do the plank and avoid dangerous exposure.

glosses: to do nothing; to do the bare minimum, to coast, to slack off, to quiet quit; to let things run their course without intervening
